    What drove the score?

    ↑ Back to the five matches

    How the model works

    We compare players who logged at least 750 regular-season minutes in . A traded player has one season profile across all teams. The team label shows their last team that season.

    Method

    The five are the other players with the smallest distances. This exact search can find close matches across the boundaries that fixed clusters would impose.

    Formulas

    How a twin earns its score

    Each stat becomes a among eligible players. For every pair, we take the absolute gap on each stat, multiply by its weight, and add the eight results. A weighted average gap of 10 percentile points earns 90 out of 100. A player compared with themself scores 100.

    Validation and research

    Basketball Reference compares career production through Win Shares. Basketball Reference

    Scott Bruce reduces tracking measurements to four dimensions; we keep eight interpretable season stats. Scott Bruce

    Hu, Yang and Xue compare shot-location patterns. Our three-point share captures one part of shot preference. Hu, Yang and Xue

    Download full methodology (.md)

    Why these weights?

    We give more weight to stats that repeated across alternating appearances in 2022–23. Basketball judgment guided the eight-stat selection.

    Why include personal fouls?

    For the eighth stat, we compared fouls per 36 minutes, turnover percentage and offensive rebound share. Fouls best matched split-game profiles. In 2021–22, they recovered the same player among the top five for 275 of 319 players, versus 268 with seven stats.

    Do the twins take similar shots?

    We compared 2023–24 matches with next-season shot locations. Among 155 players with same-position comparisons, rim share among short shots differed by 12.8 percentage points on average. Equal weights gave 12.4; assists and rebounds alone gave 14.6.

    Limitations

    A high score means similar season box scores. Players can reach those numbers through different roles, defenses and shot locations.

    Stocks combine steals and blocks with equal weight; fouls count whistles against the player. We omit screens, spacing, matchup difficulty and off-ball movement. Per-36 scaling adjusts playing time, while pace and teammates still matter.

    Match order is unstable: separate halves of 2023–24 shared 1.29 of five matches on average.

    Even unusual profiles receive five matches. Similarity cannot establish talent or replacement value.
